subject: Backend Engineer, Payments
body:
Hi Dana,

Northwind Pay's Backend Engineer, Payments post asks for recurring card mandates and Go. I've spent 4 years building Go payment services at Tidewater Freight.

There I led the mandate retry service, about 1 million requests a day, and failed mandate payments fell from 3% to 1% in its first year. I applied on 20 September. My notice period is 30 days.

Would a 15 minute call this week work? If the role is filled, a one-line reply is plenty.

Thanks,
